en: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a woman in traditional Eastern European attire standing near an ox-drawn cart. In the background is a panoramic view of a historic city sprawling across low hills, with several prominent church spires and domes visible on the skyline. The scene is set at sunset, and the cityscape has a distinctly old European architectural style. There are grapevines and other agricultural activity in the foreground.
